thread:
Alex C.: heads-up — discovered kv-cache leak causing intermittent 503s for embeddings in prod-eu during burst traffic. built a hotfix image (hotfix-v2.1.3-hotfix). request: expedited deploy in the short 00:30-01:00 UTC window, pin, and skip canary per emergency policy. need manager + oncall approvals.

DeployBot: @alex.c started a staging deploy: image redwood/serving:hotfix-v2.1.3-hotfix. staging URL: https://staging-logs.internal/redwood/1768456789. Canary default: 10% for 5m. To override, managers use `/deploy override --skip-canary`.

Jin (Oncall): I'm on it. kicking off smoke now. will run the embed regression test and the kv-cache synthetic. if staging passes i'll +1.

Alex C.: staging smoke snippets — failures reduced in repro:
```
[2026-03-23T00:17:12Z] embed-service ERROR 503 kv-cache miss timeout
[2026-03-23T00:17:13Z] embed-service INFO hotfix v2.1.3-hotfix applied, cache ttl adjusted
[2026-03-23T00:17:18Z] embed-service INFO request succeeded 200 (retries=0)
```

Maria - PM: customer-facing impact is high for a few enterprise tenants. I approve expedited. please include a short release note blurb (one-liner + impact).

Ella (Docs): I can draft the note if you give me the user-visible summary. suggested line: "Fix: kv-cache leak that caused intermittent embedding 503s under high burst load." confirm and i'll publish.

ReleaseNotesBot: Draft created for review — https://notes.internal/redwood/drafts/1768456789 (one-liner + impact + mitigation steps).

Sanjay M.: i approve. Sanjay M. +1 to skip canary and pin. DeployBot, proceed with prod rollout and set pin to v2.1.3-hotfix. note: ops agreed on 5m intense monitoring post-deploy.

DeployBot: Prod deploy starting (manager override by Sanjay M.). Pin set: `model-serving-prod -> v2.1.3-hotfix`. Canary skipped. Rolling update in progress. Rollout status: 25% -> 60% -> 100%. Logs: https://deploys.internal/redwood/1768456789.

Alex C.: monitoring live: tailing logs + dashboards. alert threshold set to 5xx > 0.5% for 1m. rollback command if needed:
`/deploy rollback model-serving-prod --to v2.1.2`

Jin (Oncall): prod smoke passed at 5m, 99.95% requests healthy, no embed 503s observed in sampled traffic. metrics: latency stable, error rate within normal. :thumbsup:

Maria - PM: thanks team. please paste the final release note link here when published.

ReleaseNotesBot: Published release note: https://notes.internal/redwood/releases/2026-03-23-hotfix-v2.1.3-hotfix — title: "hotfix: kv-cache leak fix (v2.1.3-hotfix)". Changelog line added.

Alex C.: closing loop — prod stable after 15m watch. will open a short postmortem for root cause & longer-term fix. thanks for the quick approvals. :white_check_mark:
